text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - PD-87421 - hosted-inference-east1 high-error-rate (urgency: high). Escalation policy: sre-oncall. Initial routing to matt.h.

matt.h: acked. pulling logs now, seeing spike of 5xx from model pool. will check autoscaler + kv cache.

lia.m: tagging in — if primary acked, but errors persist, PD should escalate to secondary after 2m. can someone post the error sample?

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: secondary notified (lia.m) at 3622224510 because primary ack timeout expired for follow-on tasks.

matt.h: timeline: around 09:02 UTC we started seeing queued requests > 95th pct. GPUs at 100% and some worker processes OOM'ing. quick grep of logs: 
```
2026-03-10T09:02:12Z inference: request_id=abc123 status=503 model=rf-1.3q error=kv-cache-miss backlog=182
2026-03-10T09:02:16Z host: gpu0 mem=98% pid=7231 killed_by_oom
```

olivia.r: @lia.m lia can you own customer comms if we need a short advisory? I'll prep a status doc.

lia.m: happy to. tentative impact: ~12% client requests failed, latency up x2 for 20m window. marking CA-possible.

matt.h: trying to restart hung workers on pool-08. running: 
```
# quick restart script
kubectl --context=prod-east1 -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-pool-08
```

oncall-sre: rolling restart started. watch logs for cache warmup. if restarts fail, fallback policy is to route traffic to eu-west replica.

matt.h: restart partially successful, but several pods crashloop due to eviction on node-level OOM. suspect memory regression in recent model runtime change (hotfix from yesterday).

pagerduty-bot: PD: escalation to manager (gina.m) at 3622224685 — secondary did not clear incident within policy window. Manager notified.

lia.m: @gina.m can you confirm manager bridge if we need org-level support / exec comms?

gina.m: on it. joining bridge. what's the remediation plan?

matt.h: plan A: scale up reserved pool capacity + cordon problematic nodes, then drain and reprovision. Plan B (faster): route 30% traffic to eu-west, reduce batch sizes to lower mem pressure. preferring B to reduce customer impact quickly.

oncall-sre: started network reroute to eu-west for low-priority traffic. patch applied to routing layer: `policy: latency-first -> capacity-fanout` for model=rf-1.3q.

lia.m: Olivia — draft note to customers: short degraded performance and some 5xx, mitigation in progress, ETA ~30m.

olivia.r: sending out status v1 to customer list now (internal note 1). pinging top-10 customers individually.

matt.h: quick config change pushed to reduce per-request KV cache retention (short-term) to mitigate memory thrash: `CACHE_RETENTION_MS=500` -> old was 60000. applying to pool-08.

oncall-sre: change applied. observing less OOMs. error rate falling from 12% -> 3% over 7 minutes.

pagerduty-bot: PD: monitor check — alert still firing but severity decreasing.

lia.m: customer impact update: now ~1% errors, ~100 customers affected intermittently (small % of traffic). recommending incident severity = SEV-2 and start postmortem.

gina.m: agree. request a timeline and the root cause hypothesis on the bridge. assign action items: (1) rollback runtime change (matt) (2) formal postmortem + evals to prevent perf regression (eng-reliability) (3) verify autoscaler thresholds (oncall-sre).

matt.h: kicking off rollback to runtime v2026-03-09-true. command: 
```
./deploy --service=model-runtime --version=2026-03-09-true --env=prod-east1 --no-canary
```

oncall-sre: rollback completed and traffic routed back from eu-west after stability check. running extra checks for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident PD-87421: mitigation actions applied (routing fallback, cache retention tweak, runtime rollback). No active customer-impacting alerts at 3622225025.

lia.m: thanks team. I'll file a concise incident summary + severity decision and loop in growth for any outreach. postmortem action owners: matt (rollback + regression fix), oncall-sre (autoscaler tuning), olivia (customer comms + timeline), gina (signoff).

matt.h: follow-up: I'll include logs and the commit that introduced the regression in the postmortem.

lia.m: moving to close. we'll set a follow-up async review tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
